title: live proof: large triage, approval label, approved-tier attempt
description: Items 1-3 of the unproven-loop list. The autophage-agent App has only ever run the happy path (guygrigsby/guygrigsby#2 -> PR #3): trusted owner, triage small, auto attempt, pull_request_opened, case done. Never exercised live: the Gated/AwaitingApproval states, the labeled action in internal/github/translate.go, TriageBody and OutcomeBody (the comment outbox has posted zero comments), and the approved budget tier (150 turns / 3h / 3000 lines) on ApprovedModel. Drive it by opening an issue triage will size large on the enrolled repo, confirming the case reaches awaiting_approval and the triage comment posts, then adding the approved label and watching the approved attempt run.
acceptance_criteria: A real triage comment posted by autophage-agent[bot] on a live issue; the case observed in awaiting_approval; the approved label translated to an approval; an approved-tier attempt run to an outcome.
close_reason: Proven live on guygrigsby/guygrigsby#4: triage sized large, case reached awaiting_approval, the comment outbox posted its first real comment, the approved label translated to an approval, and an approved-tier attempt ran to pull_request_opened (PR #5, 4 turns, 21.8s, 31 diff lines, $0.035 on kimi-k3). Exported metrics went from 13 to 28 series. Non-happy outcomes are still unproven; split out separately.

title: live proof: non-happy outcomes, operator run/stop, recovery
description: Items 3, 6 and 7 of the unproven-loop list, left after autophage-ufr. Every live attempt so far ended pull_request_opened with stop=none. Never seen live: budget_exhausted, failed, aborted, a second attempt on one case, the OutcomeBody comment, the operator run and stop endpoints, and Recovery resuming an attempt interrupted by a daemon restart. Blocked on shell access to the deploy host: the operator endpoints are auth-gated behind a loopback-minted token and the host is not reachable over this tailnet (not a peer, port 22 refused), so only /healthz and /metrics are visible from the Mac.
notes: budget_exhausted could be forced from GitHub alone with an issue triage sizes small but that cannot terminate, bounded by the auto tier at 40 turns / 45m. The rest need host access.

title: concurrent cases produce colliding pull requests
description: Reproduced live on guygrigsby/guygrigsby. Case #2 opened PR #3 changing README.md line 3 (HashiCorp -> Tailscale). Case #4 later opened PR #5 rewriting the same file, branched from master, which still said HashiCorp because #3 was unmerged. PR #5 therefore reasserts HashiCorp in both its intro and its new Work section, and the two diffs overlap textually. internal/agent/runner.go:349 and :543 always branch from and target repo.DefaultBranch, and nothing anywhere queries GitHub for other open autophage branches or PRs. Two cases on one repo can silently undo each other.
design: Options: have the brief name other open autophage PRs touching the repo so the agent can account for them; refuse or defer a case whose repo already has an open autophage PR; or branch from the newest open autophage branch rather than the default branch. Needs a decision before autophage runs on any repo with real issue volume.
acceptance_criteria: Two cases open on the same repo at once cannot produce PRs that contradict each other without the second attempt at least being told the first exists.

title: sandbox: disk quotas for workspaces and cache volumes, cache discard after a hostile attempt
description: Plan D final review, Important 7: memory, cpu and pids are bounded; disk is not. A looping agent can fill the deploy host's disk from bash and take Postgres down with it, and /cache/go holds GOCACHE which the next attempt on the repository executes. Add a quota (xfs project quota or a sized volume) on the workspaces dir and the per-repository volumes, and a documented policy for discarding a repository's caches after a failed or hostile attempt.

title: sandbox: egress allowlist for the networked prep container
description: Plan D final review, Important 6: a lockfile committed by one attempt makes the next attempt's networked prep container fetch from attacker-chosen hosts (go direct VCS, npm resolved URLs, uv lock urls). Go is narrowed (proxy only, -mod=readonly). Add an egress allowlist (proxy.golang.org, registry.npmjs.org, pypi.org and files.pythonhosted.org) for the prep container, via a podman network with nftables rules or a forward proxy.

title: app: enrollment retries the approved label on archived repositories for ever
description: First live run: the App was installed on every repository. Enrollment's EnsureLabel on an archived repository (guygrigsby/grigsby.dev) gets 403 'Repository was archived so is read-only' and logs 'will retry' on every sweep. Treat 403 archived as terminal: record the repository as removed (or a label_setup fact with a reason) so the sweep stops, and skip archived repositories at enrollment (the installation payload carries archived=true).

title: app: comment outbox dead-letter on a permanent GitHub 4xx

Add a comment_post_failures fact table (5NF, no nullable columns) and stop retrying after a permanent 4xx (not 401, 403 or 429), surfacing it in autophage cases.

close_reason: ConflictMarkers port method and runner guard

title: sandbox: warm-deps errors on pnpm repos without packageManager; hardening test lacks :z and :Z assertions; lease note in port doc
description: Plan D final re-review residual minors. (1) deploy/warm-deps runs corepack prepare --activate whenever pnpm-lock.yaml exists; without a packageManager field it errors and the healthy repo logs done with failures. Guard on the field. (2) podman_test.go hardening test asserts neither the :z cache mounts nor -v <ws>:/work:Z, so the SELinux half of the fix has no regression test that runs without podman. (3) image_test.sh AGENT_FLAGS omits -e GOPROXY=off -e GOFLAGS=-mod=mod that podman.go passes. (4) Port doc: Workspace.lease is unexported; a Workspace rebuilt by hand or persisted across a restart carries a nil lease and Teardown releases nothing. (5) Containers started before db8811d carry no autophage.workspace label and are not swept: one-time rollout note. (6) A second successful CommitAndPush in one attempt is refused as stale; the contracts row should say called once.
